_what: Read-only test of the checkable claims in the vendor's installed skill package (.agents/skills/battlegrid, package 31.2.13, export stamp contractVersion 53.0.0) against the live connector. Every row names the claim, the call made, what came back, and a verdict. Nothing was compiled, applied, forked, bound or deployed; the only claim that needs a compile is listed as UNTESTED with the reason. Calls were made between about 2026-09-06T00:30Z and 03:29Z (clock read at the end: 2026-09-06T03:29:21Z; individual call times not recorded). Responses are transcribed by the session from the tool results; the full column-contract responses are not stored, only the fields the claim is about.

verdict_key.PASS: observed exactly as the skill states
verdict_key.PARTIAL: true in part, with a qualification the skill does not state
verdict_key.UNRESOLVED: the observation neither confirms nor refutes (the claim lives on a path not reachable read-only)
verdict_key.UNTESTED: needs a write or an authorization not given
